essence: A deep-learning foreground/background segmenter. The user paints green (foreground) and red (background) strokes on a base frame in the Layer panel; a trained matting model infers a per-pixel alpha from those strokes and temporally PROPAGATES it across a frame span as the user scrubs. Refine Edge recovers fine/soft boundaries (hair, motion-blurred edges) via a second matting pass. The effect's PRODUCT is an alpha matte on the layer — used to isolate a subject for compositing (the film-VFX backbone: cut the actor out of the plate, put them in a new environment). The load-bearing state is the strokes + propagated matte; the 45 leaf params are all post-hoc knobs that clean/feather/choke/decontaminate/motion-blur a matte the model already produced.
when_to_use: matte a moving actor/object off a plate
clean up an existing roto edge (hair, chatter, spill)

state_model.reasoning: Split state. OPAQUE CORE: customValue count = 0, and the strokes appear only as a valueless GROUP 'ADBE Samurai Strokes Group' (no value/min/max/animatable) — the stroke geometry, learned fg/bg color model, base-frame span, and per-frame propagated matte have ZERO representation in the param tree; they live in the effect's internal Roto data store (cached to disk / persisted in the .aep), unreadable and unwritable via the param API. SCRIPTABLE SURFACE: 23 animatable scalar knobs genuinely shape the FINAL matte (Feather, Shift Edge, Contrast, Refine Edge radius, Decontaminate, Motion Blur). Opaque core + real in-params finishing surface ⇒ hybrid, not pure opaque.

opaque_core: The segmentation itself — the user's green/red fg/bg strokes, the base-frame(s), the deep-matting model's inferred alpha, and the matte propagated across the span. Entirely outside the scriptable surface (no customValue, no leaf params; only the valueless Strokes group). The product cannot create/read/edit/delete strokes, cannot trigger or read propagation, cannot know the base-frame span or where the matte is wrong. There is ALSO no scripting hook to invoke propagation — it is driven only by the user scrubbing frames in the Layer panel.

scriptable_surface.controls: Roto matte edge refinement — reshape the boundary of the matte the model produced
scriptable_surface.example_params: Feather ADBE Samurai-0009 (0-1000), Contrast ADBE Samurai-0010 (0-100%), Shift Edge ADBE Samurai-0011 (-100..100%), Reduce Chatter ADBE Samurai-0012

scriptable_surface.controls: Refine Edge pass — fine/soft (hair) edges: radius + second-stage matte shaping
scriptable_surface.example_params: Base Refine Edge Radius (0-250), Refine Edge Matte group (Smooth/Feather/Shift/Chatter), Render Refine Edge toggle

scriptable_surface.controls: Propagation recipe — steers HOW the ML re-propagates (takes effect only when the user next scrubs; does NOT hold the matte)
scriptable_surface.example_params: Search Radius (1-100), Motion Threshold, Motion Damping, Edge Detection (1-3), Quality (1-2)

scriptable_surface.controls: Matte finishing & compositing — spill removal, edge motion blur, invert, opacity, GPU
scriptable_surface.example_params: Decontaminate Edge Colors + Amount + Radius; Use Motion Blur + Samples + Shutter; Invert Foreground/Background; Effect Opacity; GPU Rendering

product_can.cap: Identify + classify this as an opaque-ML-core segmenter and route it to the handoff flow instead of trying to synthesize a matte
Pre-stage the propagation recipe (Search Radius, Motion Threshold/Damping, Edge Detection, Quality) BEFORE the user propagates, so the ML run uses the intended settings

Once a matte exists, translate a 'feeling X' request into a refine-edge recipe and set/keyframe/expression-drive every finishing knob — tighter edge (Shift Edge − / Contrast up), softer or hair edge (Refine Edge radius + feather), less boil (Reduce Chatter), spill-free comp (Decontaminate), matte motion blur matched to subject speed
Invert the matte, set Effect Opacity, force GPU/CPU, and manage compositing masks around the roto result

product_must_defer.task: Create the segmentation (the base matte) — nothing downstream is meaningful until this exists, and it cannot be scripted
product_must_defer.user_action_asked: Double-click the layer to open the Layer panel, pick the Roto Brush tool, paint a green stroke along the subject on a good base frame (Alt/Opt-drag red strokes to carve out background), then scrub forward frame-by-frame (or hold-scrub the span) so Roto Brush 2 propagates the matte; stop when it holds.
product_must_defer.then_product_can: Read that a matte exists and apply the full refine-edge + finishing recipe to the requested look.

product_must_defer.task: Re-propagate after the product changes propagation-tuning params (setting Search Radius/Edge Detection etc. does NOT re-run the model)
product_must_defer.user_action_asked: After I adjust the propagation settings, re-scrub the affected frame range in the Layer panel (there is no scripting call to trigger propagation).
product_must_defer.then_product_can: Proceed to matte finishing and edge refinement on the freshly propagated result.

product_must_defer.task: Fix the matte on specific frames where it slips (grabs background or drops part of the subject)
product_must_defer.user_action_asked: Scrub to the offending frame, add a short corrective green (add) or red (subtract) stroke, let it re-propagate a few frames.
product_must_defer.then_product_can: Continue automating all downstream refine/decontaminate/motion-blur knobs; the correction is invisible to params but the improved matte flows through.

product_must_defer.task: Freeze / cache the Roto Brush for stable playback + render once the matte is final
product_must_defer.user_action_asked: Click Freeze in the Layer panel to cache the segmentation.
product_must_defer.then_product_can: Safely keyframe the scriptable refine-edge params against a stable matte without re-triggering propagation.

perception_signal.identify: matchName 'ADBE Samurai' on a footage layer.
perception_signal.state_present_when: There is no direct param that reports matte existence (the core is opaque). Best available tells: the layer's effect has been frozen (user-side), OR the artist confirms; treat the matte as present only once confirmed. Practically the product ASKS rather than assumes.
perception_signal.state_absent_when: Freshly-applied ADBE Samurai with a valueless 'ADBE Samurai Strokes Group' and no user paint — the default state on a layer where nobody has painted. customValue = 0 always (does not distinguish painted vs unpainted — the matte is fully off-param), which is exactly why presence must be treated as unverified and gated by the handoff, not inferred.

state_gate.predicate: Has the user painted + propagated a matte for this Roto Brush instance?
state_gate.on_absent: Do NOT apply the finishing surface as if it were a result. Pre-stage the propagation recipe, then issue handoff #1 (paint + propagate).
state_gate.on_present: Automate the refine/decontaminate/motion-blur finishing surface to the requested look; keyframe against the (frozen) matte.

config_recipes.clean hard cutout (graphic/product): Shift Edge −5..−15, Contrast 60-100, Feather 0-1, Reduce Chatter 20-40 — a crisp choked edge
config_recipes.natural hair edge (actor): Render Refine Edge ON, Base Refine Edge Radius 8-20 over the hair, Refine Edge Feather low, Decontaminate Edge Colors ON amount 30-60
config_recipes.stabilized / locked matte (talking head): Reduce Chatter 50-80 + Chatter Reduction 2-3 — kill boil on a mostly-static subject
config_recipes.motion-matched matte (fast subject): Use Motion Blur ON, Samples 16-32, Shutter matched to comp shutter — the matte edge blurs with the subject

reasoning_hooks.losing hair / hard chewy edge: enable Render Refine Edge + raise Base Refine Edge Radius; add Decontaminate
reasoning_hooks.matte boils / crawls frame to frame: Reduce Chatter up (+ Chatter Reduction) — but if it SLIPS off the subject, that's the CORE, defer a corrective stroke (not a param)
reasoning_hooks.colored fringe when comped over new bg: Decontaminate Edge Colors ON + raise Amount
reasoning_hooks.nothing is happening when I set params: no matte exists yet (opaque core absent) — issue the paint+propagate handoff before any finishing param means anything

grounding: introspect card (cards/ADBE_Samurai.json — 48 params, 45 leaf, 23 animatable, customValue 0, valueless 'Strokes' group) + state-model analysis (spatial-ml-state-model workflow, 2026-07-19) + model prior on Roto Brush 2. The opaque-core fingerprint (customValue 0 + valueless Strokes group) is read directly from the introspect card; the exact refine-param matchNames beyond the top few should be confirmed against cards/ADBE_Samurai.json before setting. Confidence: HIGH on the state-model + capability boundary + handoffs; MEDIUM on individual finishing-param ranges (not visually probed — matte edits need footage + an existing matte, which is itself the handoff).
_method: introspect + state-model analysis (spatial/ML card pipeline — NO visual probe; the meaning is the capability boundary, not a param sweep)
_reference: This is the REFERENCE card for the spatial-ml cardType (canonical opaque-core hybrid). See essence/README.md for the card shape + the 3-tier classification of the class.
